title: GET /commands response
description: Revision 2. What an arbiter asked of this code's box: pending and sent, not expired, oldest first, at most 50. Fetching marks them sent; a command stays here until it is answered or expires (expires_at, 120 s after it was made). The box remembers the ids it carried out and answers a repeat with the outcome it stored. `GET /link`'s `commands` says when there are any.

tournament.description: The tournament id, as in GET /link.

board.description: The box's own board id, as its tables report gave it.

game.description: The game the arbiter saw on that board; when not null the box checks the board still feeds it (wrong_game).

kind.description: Known: confirm_guess, reject_guess, accept_draft, dismiss_draft, set_position, takeback, flip, link, unlink, restart, resync, finish. An unknown kind is answered failed / unknown_kind.

args.description: By kind: confirm_guess/reject_guess {ply}; accept_draft/dismiss_draft {draft}; set_position {fen}; takeback {plies 1-20}; flip {flipped}; link {round, board_no}; finish {result: 1-0, 0-1, 1/2-1/2 or *}; unlink, restart, resync {}.
